<!-- scenario-metadata:end -->

## Description

Verify a back swipe that starts while a custom push or pop is
still running. Pass: the running transition ends at once, the swiped screen
follows the finger, a release at a quarter of the width keeps it and a swipe
across the screen pops exactly one screen.

## Note

- Every push and pop lasts 2 seconds. Start each swipe described with "while"
  before that transition ends; wait for every other transition to finish
  before the next action.

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Launch the app and navigate to the **Stack Animation Swipe During
   Transition** screen.

   - [ ] "Home" is shown.
   - [ ] "next push" and "this screen" read `slideFromRight 2000 ms`.

---

### Swipe during a push

1. Tap "Push Blue", then, while "Blue" is still sliding in, swipe from the left
   screen edge to a quarter of the screen width and hold the finger still.

   - [ ] The left edge of "Blue" follows the finger, with "Home" visible to its
         left.

2. Release the finger.

   - [ ] "Blue" slides back to the left edge and covers the screen.

3. Tap "Push Red", then, while "Red" is still sliding in, swipe from the left
   screen edge to the right screen edge and release.

   - [ ] "Red" moves with the finger until the release.
   - [ ] "Blue" is shown.

---

### Swipe during a pop

1. Tap "Push Red" and wait for it to finish, then tap "Pop" and, while "Red"
   is still sliding out, swipe from the left screen edge to a quarter of the
   screen width and hold the finger still.

   - [ ] "Red" disappears as the swipe starts.
   - [ ] The left edge of "Blue" follows the finger, with "Home" visible to its
         left.

2. Release the finger.

   - [ ] "Blue" slides back to the left edge and covers the screen.

3. Tap "Push Red" and wait for it to finish, then tap "Pop" and, while "Red"
   is still sliding out, swipe from the left screen edge to the right screen
   edge and release.

   - [ ] "Blue" moves with the finger until the release.
   - [ ] "Home" is shown.
